title: How to Retire Early on a Normal Income
description:
You don't need a huge salary to retire early. The time it takes depends mostly on one number: your savings rate. Save 10% and it takes about 52 years. Save 50% and it takes about 17. In this video I look at early retirement from three angles: the numbers (the 4% rule and the rule of 25), the psychology behind FIRE, and a 12-step plan including healthcare and getting to your money before 59 1/2.
